experiences.description: Designed and implemented a RAG-based question-answering system to improve access to technical telecommunications documentation.
responsibilities: Developed a retrieval pipeline combining query routing, query rewriting, semantic search, BM25, Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and contextual reranking.
Implemented backend and retrieval components using Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Supabase, LangChain, and Ollama.
Integrated an LLM-based verification step to assess whether the retrieved context was sufficient to answer a query.
Built a web application prototype with authentication, document uploads, chat history, and citation-based navigation to relevant source pages.

experiences.role: Discovery and Analysis of the Fixed Access Network at Algérie Télécom

responsibilities: Studied the roles of OLT equipment, optical distribution infrastructure, and optical transport technologies.
Gained exposure to network quality indicators, maintenance practices, and technical support operations.
Connected telecommunications concepts studied academically with the operation of a large-scale access network.

experiences.role: Exploration of Telecommunications Systems and Network Technologies

Observed the practical application of telecommunications concepts in a field environment.

experiences.role: Exploration of ICT Infrastructure in Digital Organizations
